values.note: 2027: electric $28, waterfront electric $31 (sites 87, 90), full hookup $42; three non-electric sites $23. Off-season (May 1-15 and Oct 1 to close) electric $25, full hookup $38.

Reservations required before setting up, up to 12 months ahead and as late as the day of arrival, online, by phone or with the ranger/host. Holiday minimum covers Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day. Check-in 2 pm, checkout noon.

note: Wood County park 6 mi S of Pittsville on 298-acre Lake Dexter (1,235-acre park), in three wooded loops; designated waterfront sites 87 and 90 at the north end of Loop 3 face the lake through trees. A separate 10-site ATV camping area, about half a mile south, connects to the county ATV routes. Beach, fishing docks. --Claude
